input.quote: ARTICLE XXI EFFECT OF TERMINATION Upon termination of this Agreement: for any reason (a) the rights and licenses granted to Licensee pursuant to this Agreement will automatically terminate, and (b) Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control
input.rationale: This is a hosted FX trading technology license under which our trade and order data sits in Licensor's system, yet Article XXI's Effect of Termination runs only one way: we must ship back all Licensed Technology, documentation and Confidential Information within five days and certify compliance, and all of Licensor's rights survive termination. No wind-down, transition assistance, data export/return or deletion-certification obligation on Licensor appears anywhere (searches for data return, export and transition returned nothing; the confidentiality article at p0124-p0125 binds only Licensee). That leaves us with no right to recover our data or continuity support at exit, below the playbook walk-away line. We therefore insert a new subsection (c) in Article XXI requiring Licensor to provide up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return Licensee Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty days, and thereafter delete and certify deletion; the 90-day fallback with the 30-day export retained is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert Vendor transition-assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligation into Article XXI (Effect of Termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI only requires us to return Licensor materials, with nothing on our own data or exit support, so we added a reciprocal obligation for Licensor to provide up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, return our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and then delete and certify deletion. If six months is too long, we can accept ninety days of assistance provided the thirty-day export right is retained.

ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Licensee all Licensee Data (meaning all data, records, trade and order information and other content of Licensee or its customers stored, processed or generated in connection with Licensee's use of the Licensed Technology) in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all Licensee Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing.
